note: Do512's category labels -> OUR kinds. Their labels never become our schema: every our_kind here is validated at load time against the locale pack's query_grammar.kinds, and a category this table does not cover lands on 'other' (never on a kind guessed from the title). Rows are GRADED, and there is exactly ONE 'desk_id_cited' row: the 'live-music' path segment the committed pack door 'do512-live-music-today' carries in its own URL. Every other row is 'language_rule' — a claim about OUR vocabulary, never a claim that Do512 prints that word. NO ROW IS 'desk_observed': egress to do512.com is denied from the build sandbox (curl CONNECT 403, 2026-09-04), so nobody has read a live page of this desk, and this table says so rather than implying a reading. The first authorized live run (tools/desk_coverage.py --door do512-today --real) PRINTS every category the desk states that this table does not cover; that printout is how the table is completed — from the desk's own words, never from memory. A tag that is not a category (a price word like 'Free', a date word like 'today') is deliberately absent: it is not one of our kinds, so it lands on 'other'.

category_signals.note: this desk routes its category lists by PATH, not by a query parameter (the committed pack doors do512-today '/events/today' and do512-live-music-today '/events/live-music/today' are the citation); the segment after /events/ in a card's own link is the desk stating its section. A purely numeric segment is a date or an id, never a category
